bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)"
test -n "$cid"
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p="/app/runtime/chat";const a=[];for(const n of fs.readdirSync(p).filter(n=>n.endsWith(".json"))){const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p+"/"+n));for(const t of x.turns||[])if(t.error==="CHAT_STREAM_HTTP")a.push({updated_at:x.updated_at,state:t.state,error:t.error});}console.log(JSON.stringify(a.slice(-12)));const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/app/runtime/teaching-batch-20261128-1620/status.json"));console.log(JSON.stringify({batch:s.status,lessons:s.lessons.map(x=>({topic:x.topic,status:x.status,phase:x.phase,error:x.error,verdict:x.verdict}))}));'
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E 'ai-core|qwen' || true
for n in $(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E 'ai-core.*(gate|qwen)|qwen.*gate');do printf '%s\n' "$n";docker logs --since 5m --tail 150 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -oE 'MODEL_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT|GLOBAL_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT|BACKEND_[A-Z_]+|ADMISSION_[A-Z_]+|HTTP/1.1" (429|503|502|400|422)|OUT_OF_MEMORY' | sort | uniq -c || true;done
